items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah. Sheila did the singing. Lyle did the overdubs after, texture.

ctx.x: Yeah, with Kuhn, Lyle Mays, Swallow, Moses, and Sheila Jordan.
Yeah. Sheila did the singing. Lyle did the overdubs after, texture. I remember that. That was the first time I had seem Manfred since the Drum Ode debacle.
Were you on good terms with him by then?
